description: This file contains shell script code that runs automated tests for git push operations, including normal push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup operations. It simulates different scenarios, verifies outputs, and checks repository states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, runs the given commands, and verifies output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands that should fail and verifies failure.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Checks specific git references in the repository.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to produce a stable, user-friendly format.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves expected output in a specific format for comparison.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters and processes script output to remove non-deterministic parts.
